authorization: One additional fresh seed-1 100000-update run, authorized after the original v1 validation selected 30/50 and failed its 40/50 gate. This correction is a distinct model family and cannot retroactively qualify or replace v1.

training_data.normalization: Per-channel symmetric max-absolute fit over every full native TRAIN action row only; normalized action = native action / scale; floor 1e-6; no clipping, offset, validation/test fitting, or post-inference gain.

only_model_change: Training action representation and matching inference decode; all v1 architecture, observations, dataset windows, optimizer, schedule, seed, update count, EMA, horizons, and execution stride remain unchanged.
validation: All five checkpoints on the unchanged complete fixed_validation 50-scene catalog; selection is maximum successes, latest-update tie, strictly within this v2 family. Fixed test opens only at v2 >=40/50.
fixed_test: Complete unchanged fixed_base_test 100-scene catalog, v2 selected checkpoint only; qualification requires >=80/100. Neither holdout is opened by this addendum itself.
